name: 32904 · Melbourne, FL
findings: ZIP 32904 (Melbourne) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32904 (Melbourne) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32904 (Melbourne) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
